name: com.gloryday.addressables.key-generator
description:
A Unity Editor tool for GloryDay projects that automatically generates C# scripts 
containing the address keys of assets registered in Unity's Addressable Asset System.

Eliminates hardcoded address strings scattered across the codebase by centralizing 
all addressable keys into a single generated script, reducing the risk of runtime 
errors caused by typos or outdated address references.
